comments.author: AliBayan
comments.body:
Yep, only feasible for fishing (or procuring supplies), to break the 5 cargo cap.
The minimum collection level for cotton is 3, and just as guys suggest here, having the oxford skills Field activities 1 & 2 stacked, you'll gather min 4 each pickup. Which makes the collection level pretty much irrelevant to be any higher.
